name: Dire Wolf
description: A dire wolf is a larger and more fearsome version of the common wolf, known for its strength, size, and pack mentality. It is a dominant predator in its environment, capable of taking down large prey with its powerful jaws and coordinated pack tactics.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: The dire wolf bites a creature, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Pack Command
actions.description: The dire wolf commands a lower leveled ally creature within 12 units. That creature immediately uses their reaction to move 2 units and make an attack.

actions.name: Howl
actions.description: The dire wolf howls in a 6 unit radius. All non-allied beasts within the area must make a resilience check against the attack or become afraid until the end of the dire wolf's next turn. All allied beasts within the area that are lower level than the dire wolf gain 1d8 temporary health that lasts until the next full rest. This action can only be used once per day.

actions.name: Pack Retaliation
actions.description: In response to an enemy within 3 units making an attack against an allied creature lower than level 3, the dire wolf moves towards that enemy and makes a bite attack against them.

traits.name: Alpha Aura
traits.description: The dire wolf is a natural leader, inspiring allies around it. All allied creatures within 8 units that are lower level than the dire wolf gain a +2 bonus to attacks and a +2 bonus to resilience checks.
